C04 and C20 reproduce much of the same statutory machinery, but they concern less closely related disputes and thus provide weaker evidence of direct reuse.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS there exists a labor dispute between the Union Carbide and Carbon Corporation and certain of its employees ... at certain facilities of the Atomic Energy Commission located in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, and Paducah, Kentucky","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS there exists a labor dispute between the Carbide and Carbon Chemicals Corporation and certain of its employees ... at the Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Oak Ridge, Tennessee","explanation":"Both directives open with a dispute involving a Carbide and Carbon entity, represented employees, and atomic-energy operations at Oak Ridge."},{"child_excerpt":"such dispute threatens to result in a strike affecting a substantial part of an industry engaged in trade or commerce among the several States or with foreign nations, or in the production of goods for commerce, which strike, if permitted to occur or to continue, will imperil the national safety","parent_excerpt":"such dispute threatens to result in a strike or lockout affecting a substantial part of an industry engaged in trade or commerce among the several States or with foreign nations, or in the production of goods for commerce, which strike or lock-out, if permitted to occur, will imperil the national safety","explanation":"The national-emergency finding is nearly verbatim, with only minor deletion and adaptation."},{"child_excerpt":"The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title II of the said Act.
